domain.label: Domain URL
domain.description: The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

grist-create-record.label: Create Record
grist-create-record.description: Creates a new record in specific table.

value.label: Value
value.description: Enter the search text. The search operation is case sensitive, exact text match, and supports column-type Text only.

grist-update-record.label: Update Record
grist-update-record.description: Updates an existing record in specific table.

grist_list_records.label: List Records
grist_list_records.description: Lists rows of a Grist table, optionally filtered and sorted.

documentId.label: Document ID
documentId.description: The Grist document ID (a string like `kRosSWLjYzm7iaHwV6XnXM`). Get it from the **List Workspaces** action.

tableId.label: Table ID
tableId.description: The table ID, as returned by the **List Tables** action (for example `Table1`).

filter.label: Filter
filter.description: Optional JSON object mapping column ID to the list of accepted values. Example: `{"Status": ["Open", "Pending"]}`.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Optional comma-separated column IDs; prefix with `-` for descending, e.g. `-Age,Name`.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return. Defaults to 100.

grist_get_document.label: Get Document
grist_get_document.description: Gets the metadata of a document.

documentId.label: Document ID
documentId.description: The Grist document ID (a string like `kRosSWLjYzm7iaHwV6XnXM`). Get it from the **List Workspaces** action.

grist_list_tables.label: List Tables
grist_list_tables.description: Lists the tables in a document.

documentId.label: Document ID
documentId.description: The Grist document ID (a string like `kRosSWLjYzm7iaHwV6XnXM`). Get it from the **List Workspaces** action.

grist_list_columns.label: List Columns
grist_list_columns.description: Lists the columns of a table.

documentId.label: Document ID
documentId.description: The Grist document ID (a string like `kRosSWLjYzm7iaHwV6XnXM`). Get it from the **List Workspaces** action.

tableId.label: Table ID
tableId.description: The table ID, as returned by the **List Tables** action (for example `Table1`).

grist_list_attachments.label: List Attachments
grist_list_attachments.description: Lists the attachments stored in a document.

documentId.label: Document ID
documentId.description: The Grist document ID (a string like `kRosSWLjYzm7iaHwV6XnXM`). Get it from the **List Workspaces** action.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Optional comma-separated fields, prefix `-` for descending.

grist_run_sql_query.label: Run SQL Query
grist_run_sql_query.description: Runs a read-only SQL SELECT query against a document.

documentId.label: Document ID
documentId.description: The Grist document ID (a string like `kRosSWLjYzm7iaHwV6XnXM`). Get it from the **List Workspaces** action.

args.label: Arguments
args.description: Values for the `?` placeholders, in order.

grist_get_org_access.label: Get Org Access
grist_get_org_access.description: Lists the users with access to an organization.

orgId.label: Organization ID
orgId.description: Numeric org ID or subdomain from **List Organizations**. Use `current` for the site in the connection domain.
